evidence_items.explanation: The extraction results support the component that generation can reproduce learned training material. They do not establish that missing originality assessment caused the copying.

Controlled experiments identify caption conditioning and training-data properties as influences on copying, and test mitigations that change conditioning. They qualify the broad explanation but do not isolate the effect of an originality assessor.

unresolved_gaps: The retrieved studies do not compare otherwise matched systems with and without an originality assessor.
Training-data reproduction does not by itself establish literal fragment reconstruction.
The claim's broad system population and similarity threshold remain unspecified.
